log.text: A thought was planted in Chief Harlow's ear: “I heard the safety check on Barney's bakery oven expired ages ago.”
Chief Harlow overheard a stranger say: “I heard the safety check on Barney's bakery oven expired ages ago.”
Chief Harlow: A fire hazard in town right before the festival is unacceptable. I must check it.
Chief Harlow walked from the police station to Barney's Bakery
Chief Harlow looked around Barney's Bakery

Chief Harlow saw: On the surface, everything at Barney's Bakery looks normal. You can't tell whether a shop's equipment is safe just by looking at it. It takes someone who knows the trade to check it properly. Barney (the baker) is here.

Chief Harlow saw firsthand: On the surface, everything at Barney's Bakery looks normal. You can't tell whether a shop's equipment is safe just by looking at it. It takes someone who knows the trade to check it properly. Barney (the baker) is here.
Chief Harlow: Looking isn't inspecting. If that oven is a bomb, I need to know now.
Chief Harlow carefully inspected Barney's Bakery
Chief Harlow saw: The safety inspection sticker on the oven is dated two months ago. It has expired. Barney (the baker) is here.
Chief Harlow saw firsthand: The safety inspection sticker on the oven is dated two months ago. It has expired. Barney (the baker) is here.
Chief Harlow: An expired sticker is a safety risk. I can't let this slide before the festival.

Chief Harlow said to Barney: “Barney, I've seen the sticker on your oven. It's two months out of date. This is a safety violation that needs immediate attention.”
